title: Top Latch Blumcraft
description:
Blumcraft is CRL's long-standing panic device brand, now facing new competition. Its top latch had a recurring field problem: a 3° angle on the strike let the roller pop out under enough pressure. The latch also wasn't as universal as it should be, and electric-strike compatibility was limited. A competitor's fix for the electric-strike issue added cost and narrowed door compatibility.

The new security latch adds a back plate that keeps the roller latch engaged under exterior pull force, fits more door configurations, and ships with every new Blumcraft panic device order for fast market penetration. It passed Gate 4 in February 2025.

brief.label: Problem
brief.text: The top latch could fail under enough pressure, and figuring out model compatibility was unclear and slow for customers.

brief.label: Solution
brief.text: A security latch with a back plate that keeps the roller engaged, combining the best of our previous design and the competition's.

brief.label: Customers
brief.text: Glaziers, architects, glass temperers and door repair shops.

brief.label: Value
brief.text: A more secure and more universal latch at a lower cost than competing options, simplifying inventory for customers and for CRL.

brief.label: Sourcing
brief.text: Buy: from an existing hardware vendor.
